newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Opposition Democratic Progressive Party announces preliminary candidates for mayoral elections.
South Africa plans major military deal with communist China.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Robbers lift T$8.28 million from Pintung's Manchou Farmers' Credit Union.
Taipei fire kills four, injures three.
LIBERTY TIMES - Pyongyang asks third country to build ship to be used for transporting nuclear waste from Taiwan to North Korea.
Nurse accused of acting as doctor.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Stock market seen bullish before closing for Chinese lunar new year.
North Korea will set up trade office in Taiwan after Chinese lunar new year.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - China, U.S. reach textile agreement.
Government to ban housing construction on hills with greater than 30 percent inclination.
